description: Make or change Moments (moments/): a monochrome specimen sheet of twenty tactile UI micro-interactions driven by real, interruptible nonlinear physics across five materials (rubber, viscous, mechanical, taut, fluid), each playable by click, drag, scrub, or hover, with a calm loop mode, optional procedural sound, and day and night paper. Use for adding a new micro-interaction tile, tuning spring feel or nonlinear curves, fixing gooey SVG cohesion, waterline ink inversion, squash-and-stretch volume conservation, pointer interruption, procedural Web Audio feedback, light/dark contrast, or stage idle-sleep and frame pacing, even if the user never says "skill".
